inputs.text: Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, requiring new registrants to prove citizenship to vote in South Dakota state elections. The “narrow, routine safeguard” framing is the tell: they’re normalizing a new barrier, then using reassuring press-release language to keep people from asking who benefits. This looks less like a one-off measure than a test of how much restriction officials can get away with before expanding it.
